name: Mandatory Mentor
source:
Mandatory Mentor thrusts you into the high-stakes role of tutoring Reina—a hopeless, spoiled, and bratty student who only has seven days to study for and ace the University of Tokyo entrance exam. To eliminate distractions, you and Reina are forcibly exiled to a deserted tropical island to focus entirely on her studies.

Failure means the island becomes your permanent home—where coconuts and ramen are your only companions. Success? A one-way ticket back to civilization.

Will you mold Reina into a star scholar worthy of Tokyo University? Or will you fail miserably and settle into your new career as a Coconut Collector?

[From [url=https://kana-sensei.itch.io/mandatory-mentor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
强制导师将你推入一个高风险的角色，辅导Reina——一个绝望、被宠坏、脾气暴躁的学生，只有7天的时间来学习并在东京大学入学考试中取得好成绩。为了消除干扰，你和雷娜被强行流放到一个荒无人烟的热带岛屿上，以便完全专注于她的学习。

失败意味着这座岛将成为你永久的家——椰子和拉面是你唯一的伴侣。成功？一张返回文明的单程票。

你会把蕾娜塑造成配得上东京大学的明星学者吗？或者你会惨遭失败并开始作为椰子收藏家的新职业吗？

[来自[url=https://kana-sensei.itch.io/mandatory-mentor]itch.io[/url]]
